_comment: Test-stage presets for NoodlesMcDoodles. Keys are 'Section/Key' exactly as in wubarrk.noodlesmcdoodles.cfg. A preset lists every switch it sets, so applying one always gives the same state regardless of what was there before. Server presets go on the server's config; client presets on a player's own Gale profile config. Stages build on each other: switch on one step at a time. Order for a test: vanilla, m1, guards, o9, compression; zones and gameplay are held back until the server-held zone geometry is settled.

vanilla.about: Mod loaded but fully off: vanilla behaviour, for an A/B baseline.

m1.about: Default generated config: adaptive send rates and send-queue tuning on; every server-authority feature off.

guards.about: m1 + the in-use guards: the server refuses to move a container, cart, saddle, ship, smelter or creature that is in use. On their own they change nothing; O9 needs them.

o9.about: guards + latency-aware ownership: an object near several players moves to whichever of them has the lowest ping (never a building piece, ship, cart or terrain).

compression.about: o9 + compressed world-data sync to players whose client runs the mod (vanilla clients keep plain sync).

zones.about: HELD BACK (inert at default geometry, see docs/impl/INTEGRATION-REVIEW.md OPEN): compression + the server holds and simulates zones no player is standing in.

gameplay.about: HELD BACK with zones: zones + the server running spawning, wind/biome and combat-stat credit in the zones it holds.

client-default.about: Default client config (0.1.1): upload help (Q10) and the shorter extrapolation cap are on.

client-off.about: Client install changes nothing: upload help and the shorter extrapolation cap both off (vanilla client behaviour).

client-upload.about: Only upload help (Q10): this game's upload follows the same adaptive rate as the server.

client-smooth.about: Only the shorter extrapolation cap: when updates stall, others stop being guessed forward after 0.5 s instead of 2 s.
